messages:
Lisa Chen: Heads up — international candidate Karan Singh (SRE) is booked for onsite interviews on May 12 in SF. He asked about a visa invitation letter and whether we can cover a same-day airport pickup. Can someone take point on paperwork and travel logistics?
Omar Khan: I can take paperwork. Need candidate's full legal name, passport number, and travel dates for the letter. Also confirm whether he needs an I-94 or any employer letter format.
Ava (recruiter): I'll DM him now. Karan said passport ends in 4321, arriving May 11 red-eye, leaving May 13 evening. He prefers a vegetarian meal and is allergic to shellfish.
Lisa Chen: Thanks Ava. For the visa letter, use our standard "invitation for interview" template and include the interview schedule and company address. Omar, I'll share the template in thread.
Omar Khan: Perfect. @recruiter-bot can you attach the standard invite template? I'll edit with the passport and dates when Ava confirms.
recruiter-bot: Attached: /templates/visa-invite-interview.docx :paperclip:
Ava (recruiter): Got confirmation from Karan — passport 987654321, arrival 2026-05-11 23:45 SFO local, departure 2026-05-13 18:00. Vegetarian (no shellfish). He can receive a printed letter at reception or PDF by email.
Omar Khan: Drafted letter and uploaded to candidate folder: /candidates/karan_singh/visa_letter_draft.pdf. Sending to Karan for signature/confirmation.
Lisa Chen: Logistics note — we have one spare company laptop for onsite test environment. Ava, can you confirm if Karan needs a loaner or he'll bring his own?
Ava (recruiter): Karan prefers to use his own laptop but wants a company VM with preloaded repo. I can schedule a 30-min remote setup call on May 10 if needed.
Omar Khan: I'll prep a VM snapshot and a short runbook. Adding instructions to the calendar invite: 30-min pre-setup meeting May 10 10:00 PDT.
Lisa Chen: Parking/airport pickup — can we arrange reimbursed rideshare or a volunteer pickup? Sam from Eng used to help with pickups. @Omar Khan any preference? :calendar:
notes: thread about international candidate visa letter, travel and onsite logistics; contains template attachments and schedule details
